name: – Anna Strolenberg – § 48/2
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: including practices involving stopping asylum seekers and forcibly returning them to the country they entered from without carrying out an individual assessment,
part_context: Strongly condemns fundamental rights violations at borders, including practices involving stopping asylum seekers and forcibly returning them to the country they entered from without carrying out an individual assessment, ill-treatment and the use of violence by national authorities such as law enforcement and border guards; notes that such practices are often unreported and not investigated; notes, furthermore, that several Member States continue to face significant operational pressure at their external borders; underlines that these challenges require a coordinated European response, including streamlined and effective procedures, in full accordance with the applicable EU and international legal framework;
